mo_brief.title: 重要指令
mo_brief.original: Acquire Automaton samples and kill Cyborgs to aid the development of enhanced digital interrogation techniques.
mo_brief.translated: 获取机器人样本，击杀生化人，协助开发高级数字审讯技术。

items.original:
SYSTEMS NOTIFICATION

Some Galactic Map users may have observed the apparent presence of enemy forces occupying dozens of planets. This issue was due to an unconcerning software glitch that has since been rectified. 

This experience may have given rise to some uncomfortable feelings, such as concern, terror, or abject despair. Distressed users are advised to visualize relaxing images, such as:

-a fluttering Super Earth flag
-a filled-out ballot
-the inevitable destruction of Freedom's enemies
items.translated:
系统通知

部分星系地图用户或许注意到，敌军明显占领了数十个星球。该显示错误是由于无关紧要的软件故障造成的，现已得到修复。

此次经历可能会让人产生担忧、恐惧或极度绝望等消极情绪。建议情绪沮丧的用户想象令人放松的画面，如：

-随风飘扬的超级地球旗帜
-填好的选票
-自由的敌人注定走向毁灭

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Enemy aggression has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. The project has therefore been downscoped to solely consist of the Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

To aid development of more effective digital interrogation techniques, the Helldivers are ordered to acquire 35,000,000 Automaton samples and kill 60,000,000 Cyborgs.
items.translated:
新重要指令

由于敌人的侵略，麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心已无法建造。因此，该项目的规模已被缩小，仅建造人权审讯中心。

为了协助开发更有效的数字审讯技术，绝地潜兵奉命获取35,000,000份机器人样本，并击杀60,000,000个生化人。

MAJOR ORDER FAILED

The efforts of the Helldivers to support the inspiration and education of our citizens was heartlessly stolen by our enemies. Limited footage of Helldivers defending Freedom was gathered; the decision was made by the studio to instead construct the footage digitally.

The ballooning budget means that proceeds can no longer support the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

items.original:
STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY SEIZED

Helldivers have contained the outbreak on Nivel 43, securing essential footage for Democratic Sniper. Simultaneously, reports of new Terminid mutations have been investigated; the mutations were determined to be merely superficial changes, well within normal Terminid gene expression. 

The Ministry of Truth has deemed the filmed footage to be of masterfully evocative cinematic quality. As a result, the remaining major order requirements are reduced by 50%.
items.translated:
抓住战略机遇

绝地潜兵已遏制在尼维尔43发生的暴乱，而且为《民主狙击手》拍摄了关键影像资料。同时，关于终结族出现新突变的报告已完成调查；可以证实，这些突变仅为表面变化，完全处于正常的终结族基因表达范围内。

真理部认为，拍摄到的这段影像极具电影质感，足以打动人心。因此，剩余的重要指令需求减少了50%。
